targets.query:
sel = (r) => r._measurement == "levelcontrol" and r._field == "value" and (r.item == "level_meter")
before = from(bucket: "plant")
  |> range(start: -30d, stop: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: sel)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: v.timeRangeStart}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "item"])
during = from(bucket: "plant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: sel)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "item"])
all = union(tables: [before, during]) |> group(columns: ["item"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
held = all |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: v.timeRangeStop}))
union(tables: [all, held])
  |> group(columns: ["item"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 30.0}))
